description: Deterministic check of one appointment ask on a sales call using six fixed text-pattern rules: day, clock time, holding the time, confirmation question, naming what the customer asked about or promising it ready, and follow-up. Returns a structured score, per-part flags and fixes, and a fixed template example that reuses a detected day and time or supplies sample values when absent. Runs without an AI model. Use this for repeatable rule-based scoring; use review_appointment_ask for contextual AI feedback and a tailored rewrite.
